capabilities: plot notes as dots or range bars on a zoomable time axis
group notes into horizontal bands via a Base's group by
pin zoomable views to named date periods
read dates from frontmatter including BC/BCE and partial dates
open a note by tapping its plotted item
extras: The README notes the author plans tag-based or variable-driven colour selection similar to the graph view; currently colours come from Obsidian's accent palette per category.
intentEvidence: A custom Bases view for Obsidian. Notes matching a Base's filters are plotted along a horizontal, zoomable time axis
problem: Obsidian's Bases offers no built-in way to visualize notes about dated events on a linear time scale.
summary: A custom Bases view that plots dated notes as dots and range bars along a zoomable, pannable horizontal time axis.
